attribution: GeoSpec W5f void witness fixtures: replicad tubes, a revolution bend and cylinders cut with makeCylinder or makeBox, each written as a one-component XCAF assembly by OCCT STEPCAFControl_Writer with write.step.assembly 1.
runtimeDependency: All runtime inputs are files in this directory. The generator locator is attribution only and is never read by the test.
bytePolicy: Byte-locked assets: do not reformat, regenerate, or alter expectations. The STEP headers carry the generation timestamp, so regeneration is not byte-identical.

files.description: Elbow as one component 'elbow': tube r = 10 with a bore r = 6, a leg up z from 0 to 20, a 90 degree bend of centreline radius 30 about (30, 0, 20) (revolution) and a leg along x at z = 50 from x = 30 to 50; bore walls are cylinders and a torus.
Collar as one component 'collar': tube r = 15 with a bore r = 6, height 20, slit 2 mm wide through one wall (makeBox cut).
Plug as one component 'plug': cylinder r = 10, height 30, with blind bores r = 4 from both ends (z 0 to 14 and 16 to 30) leaving a 2 mm web.
